label: Source support for 197ac723 from IX.8, 1049b4–1050b6
note: The text directly argues for qualified priority of actuality and identifies which temporal claim survives the case of a capacity preceding its own exercise. To reach ActPriorInRouteSense, select a priority sense, show how it is represented by the binary RoutePrior on beings, and justify an actual witness in the same respect for each InPotency instance. Priority of an account or end alone supplies no such witness.
